text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens forming a mound in the center-right of a square white plate, dark green curly leaves with some purple-red edged leaves and a few thin orange carrot shreds, moist and slightly glossy, leaves roughly 12 cm tall and spanning about 10 cm across the plate, fairly loose and airy with visible gaps | 85

ITEM 2 | Whole cherry tomato, bright red and smooth with a glossy skin, about 2.5 cm in diameter, sitting on the left side of the greens | 15

ITEM 3 | Cluster of pale yellow-white bean sprouts with thin crisp stems and a small amount of shredded yellow-orange strands on top, slightly moist, spread over about 6 by 5 cm on the left edge of the plate, with a few thin pale slices beneath | 25

ITEM 4 | Thin pale yellow slivers and a few pale green strips, possibly dressing-coated shreds, lying across the base of the greens near the bottom left, lightly sheened, about 6 cm long | 5

ITEM 5 | Dark purple-red leaf pieces at the bottom edge of the greens, flat and slightly wilted, about 5 by 3 cm | 8
